## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry helper exceeds the five-attempt cap in the supplied project policy. The proposed policy change does not replace that review criterion.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — When an upstream consistently raises OSError, the default call makes ten attempts, exceeding the required cap of five. Cap both the default and accepted attempts at five and update the tests accordingly. — An upstream outage generates twice the permitted requests per call, increasing load and delaying failure propagation.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- Tests exercise recovery after transient failures, exhaustion, and omission of sleep after a single failed attempt.
- Exhaustion re-raises the final OSError.
